name: Cocoro
source:
"Please make me human."

A girl humanoid, model number CCR-01.

When the Calamity left the botanical garden in ruins, she was left behind and continued looking after the plants by herself. While she may be indistinguishable from a real human at first glance, she's still an early prototype humanoid. Sometimes her strange behavior and speech patterns betray her true identity. However, she stubbornly insists that she is human.

She always boasts about having a fiancé and believes that he will come to see her when the summer snows, a rare variety of flower in the garden, bloom. After she (re)meets Hinata, she begins to learn about the outside world for the first time.

[Taken from [url=https://cocoro.frontwing.co.jp/en/#CHARA]English Official site[/url]]
